metadatos.descripcion: Personal finance without spreadsheets: log expenses over WhatsApp and see your free margin and per-category budgets.
metadatos.altImagen: Mango logo with the line “Your finances, one message away”

inicio.descripcion: Mango sorts out your month: spending, income, savings and what you have left. The WhatsApp bot is by invitation.
inicio.heroTexto: Mango sorts out your month, with fixed costs, budgets and savings, and tells you how much is still free. No spreadsheets.
inicio.historiaPaso0: This is your month in Mango.
inicio.historiaPaso1: Text it like you'd text a friend.
inicio.historiaPaso2: It understands and files it for you.
inicio.historiaPaso3: And your free margin updates instantly.
inicio.historiaDescripcion: Preview of the Mango dashboard with sample data. Three WhatsApp messages log expenses and the free margin drops from €864 to €783.20.
inicio.escribeTexto: The amount and what it was for. Mango does the rest: the category, the day, and whether it was a fixed cost it was expecting.
inicio.ritmoTitulo: See the pace before you overspend.
inicio.ritmoTexto: Every budgeted category tells you how much you have left per week. You find out on day 10, not when the statement arrives.
inicio.ritmoGrafico: Food spending over the month, in euros
inicio.ritmoGraficoDescripcion: €400 budget. Day 5: 160; day 10: 310; day 15: 380; day 20: 440; day 25: 490; day 30: 530. On day 10 Mango already shows €37 left per week, twenty days before the month ends.
inicio.funcionesTitulo: Your whole month, on one screen.
inicio.margenTexto: What you have left after fixed costs and budgets. One number, always up to date.
inicio.fijosTexto: Rent, the gym or a loan in installments: Mango adds them every month on its own and shows you what's coming up.
inicio.proyeccionTexto: See how the coming months look with your fixed costs and budgets, and plan today.
inicio.presupuestoTexto: Cap food or going out and see how much you have left per week.
inicio.cierreTexto: Create your account with your e-mail. The WhatsApp bot is by invitation.
